name: Jews The
overview: Scripture reveals the Jews as a people chosen and blessed by God through Abraham, who was called to leave his homeland and promised that his descendants would become a great nation and a blessing to all families of the earth. God’s covenant with Abraham includes a promise of an everlasting inheritance of land and a multitude of descendants, emphasizing their unique role and divine favor. This foundation underscores the Jews as a special people, set apart to be a blessing, reflecting God's sovereign plan to bless the nations through them.
